orders_delivery_needs_address_parts.name: orders_delivery_needs_address_parts
orders_delivery_needs_address_parts.value:
"orders"."fulfillment_type" <> 'delivery' OR (
        "orders"."delivery_street" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("orders"."delivery_street")) > 0
        AND "orders"."delivery_ext_number" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("orders"."delivery_ext_number")) > 0
        AND "orders"."delivery_neighborhood" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("orders"."delivery_neighborhood")) > 0
        AND "orders"."delivery_city" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("orders"."delivery_city")) > 0
        AND "orders"."delivery_state" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("orders"."delivery_state")) > 0
        AND "orders"."delivery_postal_code" ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'
      )

orders_waived_fee_has_reason.name: orders_waived_fee_has_reason
orders_waived_fee_has_reason.value:
"orders"."delivery_fee_reason" <> 'waived' OR (
        "orders"."delivery_fee_note" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(btrim("orders"."delivery_fee_note")) > 0
        AND "orders"."delivery_fee_cents" = 0
      )

products_preorder_needs_cycle.name: products_preorder_needs_cycle
products_preorder_needs_cycle.value:
("products"."supply_type" = 'preorder') = (
        "products"."preorder_cutoff_weekday" IS NOT NULL
        AND "products"."preorder_cutoff_hour" IS NOT NULL
        AND "products"."preorder_arrival_weekday" IS NOT NULL
      )

products_preorder_weekday_range.name: products_preorder_weekday_range
products_preorder_weekday_range.value:
("products"."preorder_cutoff_weekday" IS NULL OR "products"."preorder_cutoff_weekday" BETWEEN 0 AND 6)
        AND ("products"."preorder_arrival_weekday" IS NULL OR "products"."preorder_arrival_weekday" BETWEEN 0 AND 6)
        AND ("products"."preorder_cutoff_hour" IS NULL OR "products"."preorder_cutoff_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23)

inventory_movements_reserve_shape.name: inventory_movements_reserve_shape
inventory_movements_reserve_shape.value: "inventory_movements"."type" <> 'reserve' OR ("inventory_movements"."on_hand_delta" = 0 AND "inventory_movements"."reserved_delta" > 0 AND "inventory_movements"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)

inventory_movements_release_shape.name: inventory_movements_release_shape
inventory_movements_release_shape.value: "inventory_movements"."type" <> 'release' OR ("inventory_movements"."on_hand_delta" = 0 AND "inventory_movements"."reserved_delta" < 0 AND "inventory_movements"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)

inventory_movements_sale_shape.name: inventory_movements_sale_shape
inventory_movements_sale_shape.value: "inventory_movements"."type" <> 'sale' OR ("inventory_movements"."on_hand_delta" < 0 AND "inventory_movements"."reserved_delta" = "inventory_movements"."on_hand_delta" AND "inventory_movements"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)
